main.description: Who may read this space. Present in every space under the group. The group authority issues space credentials according to this record and nothing else.

readableBy.description: Role ids that may read the space, or the literal string 'public' meaning any authenticated requester.

credentialScopes.description: Which OAuth scopes for the group DID each role may request in this space. A role that may write a kind of record as the group here may also publish that kind, as the group, in its public repo; '*' is any kind, in both.

writableBy.description: Who may write into the space in their own name: role ids, or 'public' for anyone signed in. Absent is any member.

role.description: A role id: the record key of a fyi.opensocial.role record.

scopes.description: Collections this role may write in the space as the group: an NSID, or * for any. Every write, unless the grant names some: xyz.task?action=create lets the role add tasks but not change or delete them.
